description:
Inflation data (HICP - harmonized index of consumer prices). Source: Bundesbank.

Parameters:
- start/end: YYYY-MM-DD
- recent: number of most recent periods

Key response fields (German names):
- hvpi_gesamt: overall HICP
- hvpi_gesamt_ohne_energie_nahrungsmittel: core inflation (HICP excluding energy and food)
- hvpi_energie, hvpi_nahrungsmittel, hvpi_dienstleistungen, hvpi_mieten: energy, food, services, rents
name: macro_inflation_hicp
title: Inflation (HICP)
